_comment: Pokemon Connect base patch for SoulSilver (same decomp and Connect source as HeartGold, built with make soulsilver) (pret/pokeheartgold + Connect, see the decomp's include/constants/connect.h). Applied in memory at launch by Gen4ConnectPatchService; every per-launch edit is a same-size write inside these archives. Gym ids are the leaders' rematch trainers in badge order (Johto 1-8, then Kanto 1-8); champion ids are Lance and his rematch.
